assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
The procedure is medically necessary to support the diagnosis of atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines.
The provider has the right to appeal this determination.
The provider should submit a formal appeal along with supporting clinical documentation within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement.
Failure to adhere to these deadlines may result in the finalization of this denial.
The provider should review the specific requirements for future submissions to avoid similar administrative issues.
